description: This file defines React components for customizable tab interfaces, including styled versions of Ant Design Tabs with additional features like overflow handling, full height, and editable tabs, used within the Superset UI project.

classes.name: Tabs
classes.description: Main tab component combining styled Antd Tabs with additional features.

classes.name: EditableTabs
classes.description: An editable version of Tabs with close icons and customizable content style.

classes.name: LineEditableTabs
classes.description: A styled variant of EditableTabs with specific appearance for line-style tabs.

methods.name: StyledTabs
methods.description: Functional component rendering styled Antd Tabs with theme-based styling and overflow/full height options.
